text: Since you've rung, here's what I wanted. What you do with Torres doesn't much interest me. He's already spent.
style: ENTROPY's recruiter, a former intelligence-agency talent spotter in her fifties, calling from somewhere comfortable. Speak with a consistent educated American (Washington DC, Mid-Atlantic) accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Low, warm pitch; slow, patient pace, never raised. Charming and empathetic on the surface, utterly ruthless underneath; talks about people as placements.
